description: Close an open trading position by placing a market order — fully or partially. This moves real money when the position is live, so confirm intent with the user before calling. Find the exchangeId, symbol, and side with get_positions. Set percentage below 100 for a partial close. A position one bot holds is closed as that bot's close (its lots, its exit record). Reports what actually closed (size, price, PnL) as the server confirmed it; when nothing closed, it returns the server's reason as an error, never "closed". Each call sends its close once. After CLOSE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, CLOSE_UNCONFIRMED or CLOSE_IN_PROGRESS the position may already be closed: never call close_position again for it without checking get_positions first.

botId.description: Optional: the bot whose position this is (its id, from list_bots). Defaults to the position's own bot when exactly one bot holds it. With a position several bots share, only this bot's share closes (at most the percentage of the whole position).

exchangeId.description: The exchange account ID where the position is open, from get_positions or list_exchanges.

percentage.description: Percentage of the position to close, 1-100. 100 = full close (default); e.g. 50 closes half.

symbol.description: Trading pair of the position, e.g. "BTC/USDT".

name: close_position
